Name: AncientSeeds_ExtraArch
Author: zylLoong
Description:
作为种田游戏,怎么不能种植古物,上古果实成熟后,如果不收获,每天都有4.2%的概率获得随机42个古物,每个作物都是0.1%,基本上都可以,但是额外的mod地图可能加载,也快了不加载
可以自定义,在config.json的第一个数据就是(源文件是固定42古物,下面的content是展示id,并无效果的)可以自定义,在config.json的第一个数据就是(源文件是固定42古物,下面的content是展示id,并无效果的)可以自定义,在config.json的第一个数据就是(源文件是固定42古物,下面的content是展示id,并无效果的)

As a farming game, why can't we grow artifacts? After the ancient fruits ripen, if they are not harvested, each day there is a 4.2% probability of obtaining one of 42 random artifacts. For each crop, the probability is 0.1%. Generally, this is acceptable. However, additional mod maps may or may not be loaded. This can be customized. The first data in the `config.json` file is used for this purpose. (The original file has a fixed set of 42 artifacts. The `content` below shows the IDs, but it has no practical effect.)
